thread:
Sam K: heads-up: running into typecheck failures in the python sdk sample app when combining autogenerated pydantic models + async streaming. filing here in case others see it.

Rina T: can you paste error and small repro?

Sam K: minimal repro: generated model has `field: list[str] | None = None` at runtime (pydantic), but the .pyi has `field: list[str]`. mypy complains: `Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "List[str] | None", variable has type "list[str]")`. also, streaming method declared `async def stream(...)-> Iterator[Item]` in stub but actually returns an `AsyncIterator`. pyright flags that.

Ben L: that's two distinct codegen issues: (1) optional defaults lost in stub, (2) sync vs async iterator mismatch. were these seen after recent stub template changes?

Sam K: yeah noticed after generator refactor last week. looks like when generator sees `= None` it drops the union. same for Field(default_factory=...) — it emits concrete type with no Optional.

Rina T: on the Field(default_factory) case, runtime type is non-None but default is a factory so consumer code can rely on value being present. However stubs should probably mirror runtime initializer semantics: if a default exists (None or factory) the attribute could be absent at construction time but post-init value may be non-None. For typing safety we should err on Optional if default is None, and preserve exact type for default_factory unless pydantic makes it Optional.

Sam K: practical fix: for any field with default None -> emit `| None` in stub. For default_factory -> keep original type (no Optional) unless field allows None. But current runtime pattern still sometimes ends up None if user explicitly sets None  so conservative Optional for default_factory might be safer.

Ben L: i'd vote for conservative: mark as Optional whenever runtime default is None OR default_factory is present, unless we can prove non-None invariant. less surprising for callers.

doc-bot: NOTE: created issue #402 in tools/autogen: "stubs: preserve Optional for None/default_factory fields and correct async iterators"

Sam K: about async iterator mismatch: generator uses a shared template that imported Iterator from typing for all streaming functions. we need to detect `async def` and import/emit AsyncIterator instead. also ensure `from typing import AsyncIterator` appears in pyi.

Rina T: small workaround for users: pin to non-strict mypy or add a local stub override. but we should fix generator ASAP since sampleapp CI shows a bunch of customers hitting this.

Ben L: i'll draft a patch: change field emission rule to `if field.default is None or field.has_default_factory: make Optional[...]` and swap Iterator -> AsyncIterator when func.is_async == True. add tests: one for mypy strict and one for pyright strict.

Sam K: adding a tiny examples/repros/typing_streams.py to sampleapp demonstrating both failures. will attach to PR.

CI Bot: ci/circle — lint-types job failed with pyright-strict errors (see https://ci.internal/402) :x:

Rina T: pinging SDK leads to backport once merged. these stubs are vendored into the hosted SDK package and affect onboarding.

Sam K: thanks all. i'll post the PR link when ready. feel free to assign review.
